verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a project-tracking tool, and its docs show it creates work items: Stories can be created from templates. The pack also mentions tracking work from people and sharing target dates, but only at the project or roadmap level. Nothing explicitly documents assigning a Story to a teammate or setting a due date on an individual task. Missing for 10: explicit story-level assignee/owner support, per-task due dates, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create tasks and assign them to teammates with due dates

citations.quote: Create Stories from a pre-formatted template, saving time and effort on commonly written Stories
Map out projects across teams, track work from people and agents in one place, communicate health status, and share target dates.
